races.paceDynamic: Atlantic City is the only confirmed front runner in this small field and should get an uncontested lead with her prominent style. The lack of early pace pressure means she can dictate terms through steady fractions, with the majority of the field - First Candidate, Dolly Drama, Flash Bardot, Rose Light and Pink Walls all holding up tactics - sitting off the pace. This creates a tactical race where Atlantic City's ability to control the tempo becomes crucial, but also sets up perfectly for the hold-up horses to unleash their finishing kicks. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses - Atlantic City may go too slow early and be vulnerable to late challengers who can quicken better off a steady pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Atlantic City sets modest fractions and the hold-up brigade get first run
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows the better-class hold-up horses to conserve energy and unleash superior finishing speed in the straight. First Candidate and Dolly Drama benefit most from this tactical setup with their proven ability to quicken off steady gallops.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Atlantic City gets soft sectionals and kicks when the field least expects it
scenarios.body: Murphy's mare exploits the tactical nature by getting first run on horses who are waiting too long to challenge. Her decent recent form suggests she has the class to make the most of ideal circumstances.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Atlantic City goes very slowly and creates a sprint finish from the back
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure speed test over the final two furlongs where natural pace and class tells. The highest-rated horses with the best finishing kicks come to the fore in a bunched finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Early Pace Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If one of the supposed hold-up horses goes forward to challenge Atlantic City early
scenarios.body: The race develops into a stronger gallop that suits horses with stamina and rhythm rather than pure finishing speed. This tactical switch catches some hold-up horses on the wrong foot.

races.paceDynamic: Bucephalus, We're Red And Blue, and Tashan will ensure a strong gallop from the start, with all three confirmed front-runners likely to dispute the early lead. The prominent brigade of Dance And Glance, Smart Decision, Frontier Prince, Inedit d'Amour, and Marche d'Aligre creates serious congestion danger turning for home as they all converge from similar positions. Hold-up horses Williethebuilder, Ice In The Veins, and Mr McLoughlan will find themselves well back early but perfectly positioned as the pace scenario unfolds. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the genuine gallop will stretch the field and create the perfect storm for patient tactics to prevail.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is truly strong and the prominent runners clash 2-3 out
scenarios.body: The genuine gallop sets up perfectly for the patient brigade, with Williethebuilder and Ice In The Veins finding clear runs as the pace-pressured leaders weaken. The Skelton stable form (9/40) and Christian Williams resurgence (3/16) provide the winning momentum.

scenarios.trigger: If one of the handy runners can avoid the traffic jam

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders go too fast and burn out before halfway
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical affair with no sustained gallop, favouring horses that can quicken from any position. Bucephalus' experience tells as the veteran finds a second wind, while the hold-up horses are caught flat-footed by the lack of pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners all arrive together in a bunch
scenarios.body: The five prominent runners create a wall of horses turning in, causing severe interference and allowing an outsider to slip through. Inedit d'Amour's low weight or Tashan's class could prove decisive in the scramble.

races.paceDynamic: Ernest Gray will likely lead from the start with no other confirmed front runners to challenge him early, allowing for a controlled, sustainable gallop over this staying trip. The prominent horses Jakar Du Moulin, I Am Max, and Porter In The Park will track the pace within striking distance, while the strong hold-up contingent of Super Survivor, Blue Carpet, Heather Honey, Secret Trix, and Walden will be held back for late challenges. With Ernest Gray unopposed early and multiple proven closers in the field, this race will likely unfold as a tactical affair with the real action coming from the back of the field in the final half-mile. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the pace will be steady rather than punishing, keeping the field compact for a sprint finish that suits late-running types.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Ernest Gray sets an uncontested lead and the pace stays modest through the middle stages
scenarios.body: The field remains bunched turning for home, allowing the talented hold-up horses to unleash their finishing kicks. Super Survivor and Blue Carpet, both proven at this level with strong closing records, can pick off the leaders in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses can get into ideal tracking positions and kick before the hold-up horses wind up
scenarios.body: Jakar Du Moulin and Porter In The Park use their tactical speed to go clear in the straight before the back markers can respond. Porter In The Park's consistent place record on good ground makes him particularly dangerous in this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If Ernest Gray's long absence tells and he fades dramatically, turning this into a sprint from the final bend
scenarios.body: The race becomes a mad dash with little galloping done early, suiting the horses with the best turn of foot regardless of position. Blue Carpet's class and Heather Honey's recent winning form make them prime beneficiaries of a messy finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Ernest Gray Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Ernest Gray's 105-day break has freshened him up and he can sustain his gallop to the line
scenarios.body: The leader kicks clear turning for home and holds off all challengers, capitalizing on his uncontested advantage. His good record on similar ground and Alan King's 4/14 recent strike rate suggest he's been prepared for a big effort.

scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders duel early and the prominent horses get drawn in
scenarios.body: The honest pace plays into the hands of the patient hold-up brigade who can time their runs perfectly. The stamina-sapping trip and strong gallop will find out the early pace-setters in the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent tracker prevails
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent horses can secure an ideal position tracking the leaders without getting embroiled
scenarios.body: Laganhill or Ski Lodge can strike the perfect balance between staying in touch and conserving energy for a well-timed challenge. Their class tells when the leaders weaken and the hold-up horses haven't quite got there yet.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace collapse aids leader
scenarios.trigger: If the two front-runners don't go hard enough early or one drops out quickly
scenarios.body: A more sedate tempo allows Saladins Son or One Last Glance to control proceedings and maintain enough in reserve. The hold-up horses find themselves with too much ground to make up in a slowly-run affair.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Stamina test eliminates many
scenarios.trigger: If the strong pace combines with the testing ground to create an extreme staying test
scenarios.body: Only the most genuine stayers survive as the race becomes a war of attrition in the final mile. Horses with proven stamina over similar trips and going come to the fore regardless of running style.

watchPoints.text: Saladins Son and One Last Glance may go too fast early and compromise each other's chances in a tactical error
Major Fortune has Harry Skelton aboard for the high-flying Skelton team with a 9/42 recent record suggesting this is well-planned
Ski Lodge has first-time tongue-tie which could spark improvement for the Alan King yard who are in decent form
Jupiter Des Bordes drops significantly in class from recent outings and the 3lb apprentice claim makes him dangerously well-handicapped
Several runners including Laganhill and If Not For Dylan are returning from breaks of 40+ days which could impact fitness levels
